mcp-atlassian.description: Jira + Confluence access (sooperset/mcp-atlassian, run via uvx) for ticket ingestion and doc/handoff publishing. Non-secret fields (URLs, usernames, project/space filters) come from /vinsap:config → .sdlc/config.json. API tokens are NEVER stored in config or committed files — set JIRA_API_TOKEN and CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN as real environment variables in your own shell/profile; the ${VAR} placeholders below are resolved from your environment at launch, not from this file.
